framework.name: Enhanced human wellbeing, capabilities and equality in Georgia by 2030
framework.description: Building on the national SDG progress and keeping in mind that “leaving no one behind“ is the central approach to this Cooperation Framework, the UN in collaboration and consultation with the Government of Georgia and other stakeholders will address the development challenges to achieve the vision based on one joint transformative strategic priority: Enhanced human well being, capabilities and equality in Georgia by 2030

children.name: Outcome 1: By 2025, all people in Georgia enjoy improved good governance, more open, resilient and accountable institutions, rule of law, equal access to justice, human rights , and increased representation and participation of women in decision making
children.description: Outcome 1: By 2025, all people in Georgia enjoy improved good governance, more open, resilient and accountable institutions, rule of law, equal access to justice, human rights , and increased representation and participation of women in decision making

children.name: 1.1. Inclusive national and local governance systems have greater resilience and capacities to mainstream gender, migration and ensure evidence-based and participatory policy-making, map and address inequalities and deliver quality services to all
children.description: 1.1. Inclusive national and local governance systems have greater resilience and capacities to mainstream gender, migration and ensure evidence-based and participatory policy-making, map and address inequalities and deliver quality services to all

children.name: 1.2. National legislation and policies to eliminate discrimination, enhance human rights and equal access to justice in Georgia
children.description: 1.2. National legislation and policies to eliminate discrimination, enhance human rights and equal access to justice in Georgia

children.name: 1.3. Legislative frameworks, policies and governance systems deliver gender-equal results, combat GBV, violence against children and other harmful practices towards women and girls
children.description: 1.3. Legislative frameworks, policies and governance systems deliver gender-equal results, combat GBV, violence against children and other harmful practices towards women and girls

children.name: Outcome 2: By 2025, all people in Georgia have equitable and inclusive access to quality, resilient and gender-sensitive services delivered in accordance with international human rights standards
children.description: Outcome 2: By 2025, all people in Georgia have equitable and inclusive access to quality, resilient and gender-sensitive services delivered in accordance with international human rights standards

children.name: 2.1 Improved national capacities for the implementation of policies and programmes that ensure equitable access to and coverage of quality integrated health and nutrition services and the exercise of reproductive rights for all people, particularly, those left behind
children.description: 2.1 Improved national capacities for the implementation of policies and programmes that ensure equitable access to and coverage of quality integrated health and nutrition services and the exercise of reproductive rights for all people, particularly, those left behind

children.name: 2.2. Improved national capacities for the implementation of policies and programmes that ensure inclusive and equitable access to quality educational programmes that meet international standards
children.description: 2.2. Improved national capacities for the implementation of policies and programmes that ensure inclusive and equitable access to quality educational programmes that meet international standards

children.name: 2.3.Improved national legislation, policy, programs and capacities protect all people in Georgia, especially the most vulnerable and marginalized, against discrimination and ensure equitable access to and coverage of quality social services
children.description: 2.3. Improved national legislation, policy, programs and capacities protect all people in Georgia, especially the most vulnerable and marginalized, against discrimination and ensure equitable access to and coverage of quality social services

children.name: Outcome 3: By 2025, all people without discrimination benefit from a sustainable, inclusive and resilient economy in Georgia
children.description: Outcome 3: By 2025, all people without discrimination benefit from a sustainable, inclusive and resilient economy in Georgia

children.name: 3.1.Improved competitiveness and social responsibility of private sector
children.description: 3.1. Improved competitiveness and social responsibility of private sector

children.name: 3.2. Sustainable and inclusive agricultural and rural development, strengthened food systems and improved livelihoods.
children.description: 3.2. Sustainable and inclusive agricultural and rural development, strengthened food systems and improved livelihoods.

children.name: 3.3. Increased productive employment, decent work, skills development and effective national social protection for all
children.description: 3.3. Increased productive employment, decent work, skills development and effective national social protection for all

children.name: Outcome 4: By 2025, conflict affected communities enjoy human rights, enhanced human security and resilience
children.description: Outcome 4: By 2025, conflict affected communities enjoy human rights, enhanced human security and resilience

children.name: 4.1 Improved access to essential services for conflict-affected communities
children.description: Conflict affected communities have improved access to essential services, including education, healthcare, GBV response and legal assistance

children.name: 4.2 Improved socio-economic conditions, resilience and self-reliance in conflict-affected communities
children.description: Socio-economic conditions, community resilience and self-reliance improved with programmes benefiting conflict affected communities particularly those left behind

children.name: 4.3 Strengthening civil society, community resilience, social cohesion and WPS agenda
children.description: Space widened for dialogue and participation that strengthens civil society, community resilience, social cohesion and implementation of Women, Peace and Security agenda

children.name: Outcome 5: By 2025, all people, without discrimination, enjoy enhanced resilience through improved environmental governance, climate action and sustainable management and use of natural resources in Georgia
children.description: Outcome 5: By 2025, all people, without discrimination, enjoy enhanced resilience through improved environmental governance, climate action and sustainable management and use of natural resources in Georgia

children.name: 5.1 Environmental governance and institutional capacity enhanced to enable rational, equitable and sustainable use of natural/land resources, to ensure conservation of ecosystems and make communities more resilient to environmental shocks;
children.description: 5.1 Environmental governance and institutional capacity enhanced to enable rational, equitable and sustainable use of natural/land resources, to ensure conservation of ecosystems and make communities more resilient to environmental shocks;

children.name: 5.2. Climate-sensitive, resilient and risk-informed development ensured, without discrimination,  in AFOLU, health, water safety, construction, energy and food production sectors to increase adaptive capacities and mitigate impact of climate  change pursuing LDN (Land Degradation Neutrality)
children.description:

children.name: 5.3. Innovative and climate-friendly technologies used for inclusive green economy, energy efficiency and clean energy production to enhance NDCs (Nationally Determined Contribution) and support long-term decarbonization strategies
